name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Maumelle AR

fieldNotes.truckGate: Channelized multi-lane entrance drive off Champs Blvd with painted directional lane arrows, gate barrier cross-bars spanning the lanes, and a median equipment cabinet, visible at z20 satellite (34.8676,-92.3837). Controlled checkpoint, not an open driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white booth structure at the head of the entrance drive where lanes open into the yard (~34.8680,-92.3835), with a separate median gate-equipment cabinet beside the inbound lanes. New $175M corporate DC; staffed-booth footprint consistent on satellite.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Entrance apron is very wide with multiple channelized lanes and ample unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks present on both the south face and the north face of the building (trailers backed in on both), consistent with separate shipping/receiving clusters; medium confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 1.15M sq ft building with continuous dock aprons on south and north faces; full-length bays put total well into the 50+ band (estimate ~120 doors).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dozens of marked trailer-drop stalls filled across the south yard and the east wrap-around yard; clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: ~2 inbound lanes read from painted arrows at z20; exact split low confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: ~1 outbound lane read from painted arrows; low confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park at the north edge of Maumelle, bounded by woodland on the east/south; broader setting is small-town/rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is offsite.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron inside the gate before the dock approach provides queue/holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach is long and can stack 3+ trucks.

citations.claim: TSC grand opening of its tenth and largest distribution center (1.1M sq ft, $175M) in Maumelle, AR; began receiving April 2024 and shipping June 2024.
Maumelle Chamber of Commerce member directory lists 'Tractor Supply Company Maumelle Distribution Center #850' as an active local business.

verification.rationale: Tier-1 IR press confirms grand opening with shipping from June 2024; 2+ years operational now, corroborated by active chamber listing; not under construction.
